allow_instructions: Ordinary work in this Flutter repo can auto-run: reading and editing project files, running tests, analyze, format, pub get/upgrade, build_runner, flutter build/run, and git status/diff/log/add/commit.
Sandbox-safe shell commands that inspect the workspace or use Dart/Flutter tooling can auto-run.
Commands that only need workspace file access and standard package-manager network such as pub.dev can auto-run.
block_instructions: Commands that delete files, wipe git history, force-push, or modify git config/hooks should go through approval first.
Commands that change files outside this workspace, touch SSH keys, or need unrestricted system access should go through approval first.
